preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The constant m is at least 1.
The number of subarrays k is at least 2.
The product of m and k does not exceed n.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the array a is between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: sum_of_beauties == sum(sorted(subarray)[-m:] for subarray in subarrays)
postconditions.description: The sum_of_beauties is the sum of the beauties of the k subarrays.
The number of subarrays is exactly k.

postconditions.expression: all(len(subarray) >= m for subarray in subarrays)
postconditions.description: Each subarray has at least m elements.

postconditions.expression: all(a[i] in subarrays[j] for j in range(k) for i in range(p[j-1] if j > 0 else 0, p[j] if j < k-1 else n))
postconditions.description: Each element from a belongs to exactly one subarray.
The number of partition points p is exactly k-1.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i < n for p_i in p)
postconditions.description: Each partition point p_i is between 1 and n-1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(p_i < p_j for i, j in zip(range(k-1), range(1, k-1)))
postconditions.description: The partition points p are in strictly increasing order.
